design: llamacpp_own_tokenization vs llamacpp_hf_token_ids isolates tokenization with engine, weights and sampler held constant. hf_transformers is a pinned-weight cross-check under a different engine and is reported separately; it is NOT a reconstruction of the frozen vLLM 0.29.0 reference, whose per-example predictions were not preserved.
